name: Azure DevOps Services
covers: Work items, boards, backlogs, sprints, repos, pull requests, comments, votes
credentialWhere: User settings → Personal access tokens → New Token, with Organization set to one organization
credentialNote: Global tokens (all accessible organizations) stop working on December 1, 2026, so create one per organization. In Azure Pipelines, map $(System.AccessToken) and $(System.CollectionUri) to TOIL_ADO_CLOUD_PAT and TOIL_ADO_CLOUD_BASE_URL

supported.note: Azure DevOps Services is always current. toil sends api-version=7.1, the newest released version (7.2 is preview only), with an organization-scoped personal access token as Basic auth. Its work item reads and team settings commands have been run against one live Scrum organization; its pull request commands have not.
